name: Black Bear
appearance: A comparatively small bear with dense fur ranging from black to light brown.

Special attacks.name: Hug
Special attacks.effectNote: On a successful paw hit with an attack roll of 18 or better, the bear deals an additional 2d4 damage with a hug.

Habitat and behavior.name: Behavior
Habitat and behavior.effectNote: The most widespread bear in the family entry generally avoids people unless provoked.

notes: 1–3 appearing. Common. Family groups. Active by day. Omnivore.
Semi-intelligent (2–4). Neutral. Average (8–10) morale. Treasure, special defenses, and magic resistance Nil. No fixed HP.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), p. 17.

name: Brown Bear
appearance: A large bear with dense fur and a heavy grizzly build.

Special attacks.name: Hug
Special attacks.effectNote: On a successful paw hit with an attack roll of 18 or better, the bear deals an additional 2d6 damage with a hug.

Habitat and behavior.name: Behavior
Habitat and behavior.effectNote: It is more carnivorous than the Black Bear and the grizzly can hunt large prey such as deer and elk.

Combat behavior.name: Fighting at negative HP
Combat behavior.effectNote: The bear can continue fighting for 1–4 melee rounds at 0 through −8 HP. It dies immediately at −9 HP or fewer.

notes: 1–6 appearing. Uncommon. Family groups. Active by day. Omnivore.
Semi-intelligent (2–4). Neutral. Average (8–10) morale. Treasure, special defenses, and magic resistance Nil. No fixed HP.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), p. 17.

name: Cave Bear
appearance: A very large bear with dense fur and massive forequarters.

Special attacks.name: Hug
Special attacks.effectNote: On a successful paw hit with an attack roll of 18 or better, the bear deals an additional 2d8 damage with a hug.

Habitat and behavior.name: Behavior
Habitat and behavior.effectNote: An aggressive bear that may attack even an armed group. Its diet leans toward meat.

Combat behavior.name: Fighting at negative HP
Combat behavior.effectNote: The bear can continue fighting for 1–4 melee rounds at 0 through −8 HP. It dies immediately at −9 HP or fewer.

notes: 1–2 appearing. Uncommon. Family groups. Active by day. Omnivore.
Semi-intelligent (2–4). Neutral. Average (8–10) morale. Treasure, special defenses, and magic resistance Nil. No fixed HP.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), p. 17.

name: Polar Bear
appearance: A huge white-coated bear with smaller rounded ears and a long muzzle.

Special attacks.name: Hug
Special attacks.effectNote: On a successful paw hit with an attack roll of 18 or better, the bear deals an additional 3d6 damage with a hug.

Habitat and behavior.name: Behavior
Habitat and behavior.effectNote: A powerful swimmer that feeds mostly on marine animals.

Combat behavior.name: Fighting at negative HP
Combat behavior.effectNote: The bear can continue fighting for 2–5 rounds at 0 through −12 HP. Below −12 HP it dies immediately.

notes: 1–6 appearing. Rare. Family groups. Active by day. Omnivore.
Semi-intelligent (2–4). Neutral. Average (8–10) morale. Treasure, special defenses, and magic resistance Nil. No fixed HP.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, third printing (January 1994), p. 17.
